items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I said that I was studying music, and Johnny Hodges, my idol, was playing with the Duke Ellington band

ctx.x: Oh yeah. But they had a section, a special section for them, where they had these bench-like seats, you know, almost like a stadium type seat -- and they would sit in that section and hear the band. You know, they couldn't come down and dance, but they could sit up there and hear the band.

So when Duke Ellington came to town, I... I was determined to hear Johnny Hodges. So they were playing a dance down at the White armory, they was playing...at the White auditorium downtown. I was about fourteen. So I went down there. And they had this big guy, you know, like the security guy by the front, by the door, you know... So I went up to him and I told him...I said that I was studying music, and Johnny Hodges, my idol, was playing with the Duke Ellington band, and I really wanted to hear him, you know.…
